scope: Read-only local payload/manual/syntax review. Writes restricted to /private/tmp/codex-keep-awake-review.md and .json.
authority: Root supplied the current user's explicit request for durable prevention of idle Mac unavailability. This covers the new user LaunchAgent; it does not grant unrelated production/account/security changes.

findings: -u declares active user, may turn a dark display on; -t supplies the assertion timeout instead of its five-second default.

manual_evidence.read: Targeted sections of MANPAGER=cat man launchd.plist
findings: KeepAlive true requests continuous running and restart; rapid failures are throttled.
KeepAlive implies RunAtLoad; explicit RunAtLoad is redundant but valid.

installation_conditions: Recheck that only the allowlisted destination and label are being installed and that neither already exists as another owner's file/service. Do not overwrite, replace or boot out an existing unrelated job.
Install exactly the reviewed payload into the current user's LaunchAgents folder; do not create a system daemon or use root credentials.
Use normal platform approval flow if needed; no workaround for rejection.

After bootstrap, verify the loaded service's actual arguments/PID and PreventUserIdleDisplaySleep, PreventUserIdleSystemSleep and UserIsActive assertions attributed to that PID, not merely aggregate assertions supplied by the temporary process.
Treat successful next-login start and 24-hour renewal as EXPECTED until observed, not tested guarantees.
operational_effects: Continuously suppresses idle display/system sleep and declares user activity while the agent runs in the logged-in GUI session. The screen may remain lit and the unattended desktop may stay available.
The payload is not AC-only. It can increase battery use and keep the display awake on battery.
This does not promise to defeat manual lock, lid-close sleep, logout, reboot/login barriers, power loss, MDM/security policy or unrelated browser/tool/authentication failures.
excluded_changes: Existing agents or other owners' files

rollback.second: Confirm this exact installed file remains a regular file with SHA-256 572e7b451fa9c4f8ecbbd4fe124e890f545aced4e7aca95244d0da95ad6ced6b, then remove only /Users/fsuels/Library/LaunchAgents/com.fsuels.codex-keep-awake.plist. Preserve the file if its identity or hash differs.
rollback.limit: KeepAlive means killing the child alone is not durable rollback. Other assertions, including the separately running temporary caffeinate, are not removed by this rollback.

limits: No service bootstrap, assertion creation, native interaction or 24-hour/relogin test performed by this reviewer.
The root's temporary assertions are reported context, not independently verified here.
